Carmen Ortiz: Following the postmortem, we need a concrete remediation roadmap that covers short-term fixes + longer-term recurrence prevention for the span loss / bad aggregation issues. Who can take temporary owner for the 6-week watch?

Ben Kwan: I'll own the 6-week watch. First steps: (1) add a recurrence dashboard (daily deltas, backfill rate, ETL lag percentile), (2) schedule a weekly triage sync, (3) own pager config for regressions.

Rina Shah: I'll pick up the aggregator correctness fixes. Root cause summary: key-collisions in the per-shard map when cardinality exploded -> silent drop. Plan: make the reducer use a stable hash + overflow spill to disk when map > 1M keys, add fuzz tests, and add a canary mode. ETA: prototype by Fri, PR next Wed.

Omar El-Sayed: I'll handle the ingestion watermarking/ETL lag side. I found the watermarking logic occasionally stalled when downstream compaction took longer than our watermark TTL. Short-term: increase TTL to reduce false positives; long-term: make watermark advance idempotent and resilient to compaction pauses. Target config change tomorrow, code change in two sprints.

Carmen Ortiz: Good. For the backfill we need to ensure idempotency and rate-limited writes so we don't create further instabilities. Any concerns about write amplification?

Ben Kwan: Backfill plan: chunk windows, write to a dedicated backfill topic (to avoid normal ingestion paths), and have a progress table. We'll also cap the write rate to 200MB/s per service. I'll add the backfill job to canary infra first.

Rina Shah: Tests I'll add: unit reducer tests, large-scale integration test emulating cardinality burst (using the load-generator), and a regression test in CI that replays a saved failing trace set. Will attach test data to the PR.

sre-bot: incident note: observability:span-mismatch spike detected 2026-03-12T09:12:44Z (counts delta > 1000 for service auth-proxy)

Emma Lu: On customer comms: we should draft two templates: (1) short status to affected customers, (2) postmortem summary. I'll coordinate with CS and legal. Timeline: status note within 24h, full postmortem in 5 days.

Omar El-Sayed: For monitoring, propose these alerts: delta > 500 -> ops-notify channel, delta > 2000 -> paging to oncall, ETL lag p99 > 5m -> ops-notify. Also add a synthetic trace ingestion every 10m to validate the full pipeline.

Ben Kwan: Agree. Also proposing an automated rollback detector: after a deploy, run the nightly aggregation check for 1h and auto-roll back if delta increases by > 20%. Low-friction safety.

Carmen Ortiz: Love the rollback detector idea. We should also update the runbook so the oncall can follow a clear playbook: quick triage steps, when to trigger backfill, contacts, and post-incident documentation checklist. I'll open the runbook PR.

Rina Shah: Implementation note: the stable-hash + overflow will increase I/O. I'll quantify perf impact in the spike. If too high, alternative is a streaming partial-aggregate flush every N keys.

Ben Kwan: If we see recurrence after fixes, we'll consider a longer-term change: routing heavy-cardinality services to a dedicated aggregation shard or separate reducing cluster. That's a capacity + infra project (Q2).

Emma Lu: I'll flag affected customers and ask CS to collect any dashboard examples so we can correlate. Also will include FAQ for common asks (data retention, accuracy window).

sre-bot: scheduled check created: observability.recurring-span-check (every 10m)

Carmen Ortiz: Action summary (owners & near-term ETA): 1) 6-week watch + dashboard (Ben) - dashboard by Wed, weekly triage starting next Mon. 2) Aggregator fix (Rina) - spike Fri, PR Wed. 3) Watermark/ETL adjustments (Omar) - config change tomorrow, code plan in 2 weeks. 4) Customer comms (Emma) - status within 24h, postmortem in 5d. 5) Runbook + rollback detector (Carmen/Ben) - runbook PR today, detector spike Mon.

Ben Kwan: I'll update the tracking ticket and add checkboxes for each milestone. Will post links here once created.

Rina Shah: Will add the regression test vector to the CI and include steps to run locally in the PR.

Omar El-Sayed: Noted. I'll run the canary for watermark TTL change in staging tonight and report results.

Carmen Ortiz: Thanks everyone. If any ETA slips, post updates here. We'll re-check recurrence metrics in 7 days. :spiral_calendar:
